name: omniagent
description: Installable, permission-bounded, multi-platform agent skills & subagents by FluxonLab.

plugins.name: omniagent-ai-and-agent-systems
plugins.description: Agent workflow design, governance, prompt systems, RAG/vector search, LLM evaluation, and MCP gatekeeping.

plugins.name: omniagent-backend-and-api
plugins.description: API/interface design, backend review, auth/session, integration boundaries, error handling, and Python project review.

plugins.name: omniagent-core-operations
plugins.description: Repo diagnostics, architecture review, implementation planning, refactor safety, release readiness, and project bootstrap.

plugins.name: omniagent-database-and-data
plugins.description: Prisma, Postgres/Supabase, migrations, seeds/fixtures, query performance, and RLS/edge functions.

plugins.name: omniagent-devops-and-release
plugins.description: CI/CD, build & typecheck, deployment preflight, release notes, and handoff readiness.

plugins.name: omniagent-frontend-web-design
plugins.description: UI consistency, web/design-system review, accessibility, dashboards, landing pages, responsive layout, i18n parity, Next.js RSC, and shadcn/ui.

plugins.name: omniagent-gaming-interactive-media
plugins.description: Game architecture, gameplay systems, game UI/UX, performance, prototypes, engine triage, and browser-game stacks (Phaser, Three.js, PixiJS).

plugins.name: omniagent-mobile-desktop
plugins.description: Mobile app review, iOS HIG, Android Material, and desktop launcher review.

plugins.name: omniagent-optional-specialist
plugins.description: Domain specialists: WordPress/WooCommerce, e-commerce, NFC/linktree, local LLM runtime, Chrome extensions, maps/geo, print design, analytics, SEO, cost control, observability, and monorepo.

plugins.name: omniagent-product-docs-and-research
plugins.description: Spec/markdown generation, execution prompts, requirements, market research, business model, pricing, technical writing, and ADRs.

plugins.name: omniagent-runtime-and-local-app
plugins.description: Local-first apps, runtime diagnostics, startup/health gates, launchers, and log bundles.

plugins.name: omniagent-security
plugins.description: Secrets, AI/prompt-injection, authz/permissions, dependency supply chain, env hardening, and Electron app security.

plugins.name: omniagent-skill-library-and-installation
plugins.description: Skill librarian, deduplication, skill-to-agent routing, installation audit, and path hygiene.

plugins.name: omniagent-testing-and-qa
plugins.description: Smoke test & repair, Playwright E2E, regression scope, API test suites, visual regression, and UAT acceptance.
